spans.s:
dhána, n.
 —1. the prize of the contest;
not only the reward put up for the victor,
but also the booty taken from the foe--
Vedic; so w. √ji, win booty by conquest,
81^2; then,
 —2. in general, wealth, riches,
property, money. [√dhā, ‘put’: cf. θέμα,
‘thing put up as a prize,’ and for the mg
also Ger. Ein-satz, ‘stakes.’]
dhānā́, f. pl. corns, i. e. grain.

dhanu, m. bow. [fr. dhanus, a transfer
to the u-declension.]

dhanuṣ-kāṇḍa, n. bow and arrow.
[dhanus: see 1253b.]

dhānyà, a. cereal (adj.); as n. cereal
(noun), grain. [dhānā́.]

dhanvin, a. subst. having a bow, bowman.
 [dhanvan, 1230b.]
